goal: Import the sample sine wave audio stem, duplicate the track, and adjust playback volume in Audacity.

input_targets: File Open or Import Audio Dialog
input_purposes: Path to sample sine wave audio track: fixtures/audio/sample_sine_440hz.wav
required_sequence: Open or import sample audio file fixtures/audio/sample_sine_440hz.wav
Verify the audio waveform track appears in the workspace
Select track and choose Duplicate or adjust gain slider
Verify audio session has active tracks
success: Audacity workspace contains an active audio track loaded from sample_sine_440hz.wav
